records.officialDescription: Introducing the world's 1st ever Carbon Neutral Mat Spray. Designed to effortlessly and creatively revitalize your old furniture and decorative items with a stunning chalk matte effect. Perfect for DIY enthusiasts and professionals alike. It comes with two spray nozzles, catering to both small and large surfaces. The advanced spray system minimizes painting time, eliminates dripping, and dries quickly. Transform your old items in just 15 minutes, easily and economically, without the need for tools or special skills. Available in 24 unique shades, it's the ideal solution for bringing new life to your space.

Ideal for application on doors, windows, window frames, pergolas, garden furniture, and any wooden surface, ensuring both protection and an attractive aesthetic result.
